methodology: To perform the analysis, I systematically decomposed the provided information into atomic units by identifying distinct requirements, features, and behaviors described in each input. Each unit was defined to be independent, specific, and implementable as a single requirement.
mindtraced_atomic_units: Create a module implementing 8 D flip-flops.
Each flip-flop has an active high asynchronous reset.
The asynchronous reset sets the output to 0 immediately when high.
All flip-flops are triggered by the positive edge of the clock signal.
The module has an input clock signal 'clk'.
The module has an 8-bit input data signal 'd'.
The module has an input asynchronous reset signal 'areset'.
The module has an 8-bit output signal 'q'.
